title: Flatten Linked List with Bottom Pointers
problemStatement: You are given a linked list where each node contains: next pointer bottom pointer Each bottom list is individually sorted. Flatten the entire structure into a single sorted linked list using only the bottom pointers. Return the head of the flattened list.
input: A linked list with next and bottom pointers.
output: The head of the flattened sorted linked list.
constraints: Total number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5]
